content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on experience, supported opinion, contrast, and tactful awareness of another view. Notice how the ideas about a weekly screen-free evening are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: I have tried a screen-free evening every Wednesday for a month. In my opinion, it is helpful because I sleep better; however, I understand why some people need to stay available online.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about a weekly screen-free evening. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
content_sections.title: Guided use
